title: Jubilant Golden Dutch Cheese Casserole
description: A kid-friendly Dutch dish featuring maple syrup and a winey cheese pull, made in a copper pot with render fat for a rich flavor, halal friendly.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente, then set aside.
In a copper pot, heat the render fat over medium heat until melted.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add white wine and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, shredded cheese, milk, maple syrup, salt, and pepper, and stir until well combined.
Add the pasta mixture to the copper pot and stir until the cheese is melted and the mixture is heated through.
Transfer the copper pot to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
